### Primary prompt (use with a real photo, not fake likeness)

If you regenerate / composite from a licensed still (Getty is already linked in the post):

```
Editorial blog hero crop of Filipina tennis player Alexandra "Alex" Eala on court in ready stance, black Nike visor, long dark braid, focused expression looking past camera. Bright daylight hard-court blues and soft bokeh stadium wall. Leave the entire right third as clean negative space (blurred court/wall, no ads, no screens). Photorealistic sports photography, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, sweat sheen, sharp racket details. No text, no logos overlays, no watermarks, no UI, no purple LED board, no graphic title cards. Cinematic color grade, slight warm highlights, cool court shadows. Aspect ratio 16:9, 1920x1080 or larger, high resolution.
```

**Negative / avoid:** `text, typography, title overlay, watermark, barcode, LED screen, purple panel, motion blur smear, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed racket, low resolution, collage seams`

---

### Alt prompt (Wimbledon peak — matches post’s emotional core)

```
Editorial wide hero of a young Filipina tennis pro celebrating on green grass Centre Court, white kit, racket raised, crowd soft-blurred in background, golden late-afternoon light cutting across grass. Quiet triumph, not fireworks. Negative space on the right for layout breathing room. Photoreal sports photo, 16:9, 1920x1080+, no text, no logos burned in, no scorebug.
```

### Practical tip

For a living athlete, **licensed Getty/WTA still + crop** beats AI face. Drop text from the image — Hugo already prints the title. Target **≥1600px wide**, **16:9** (or **1200×630** for social). Save as `assets/images/alex-eala.jpg` (or `alex-eala-hero.jpg` and update frontmatter).

### Edit / enhance prompt

```
Improve this photo into a clean editorial blog hero. Keep the same person, face, body proportions, braid, clothing, and racket exactly as in the source — do not invent a new likeness. Upscale and sharpen for web: crisp eyes, natural skin texture, realistic sweat and fabric detail, clean racket strings. Remove any text, title overlays, watermarks, scorebugs, and graphic labels. Replace the busy purple LED screen / digital panel behind her with a soft out-of-focus blue stadium wall and court bokeh so the right side becomes calm negative space. Keep bright natural daylight and hard-court blues. Photorealistic sports photography only — no illustration, no collage seams, no plastic skin, no extra limbs. Aspect ratio 16:9, output 1920x1080 or larger. No text of any kind in the final image.
```

### Negatives

```
text, typography, watermark, logo overlay, LED screen, purple billboard, scan lines, UI, low resolution, blurry face, warped hands, deformed racket, plastic skin, AI artifacts, double face
```

### Tool tips

- **ChatGPT / Gemini image edit:** attach the CC file, paste the prompt, say “edit this image, don’t redraw her face.”
- **Flux Kontext / similar:** strength ~0.35–0.55 so likeness holds; higher only if background needs a full rebuild.
- **If tool keeps redrawing her:** add `identity lock: preserve facial features 100% from reference photo`.

Crop after: subject left third, empty right third — Hugo title sits on the page, not on the image.
